subject: social
name: Social Studies
course: World Communities, Global Geography & Indigenous Cultures
title: Grade 3 Social Studies: World Communities, Global Geography & Indigenous Cultures
overview: Grade 3 Social Studies builds civic competence, geographical literacy, economic understanding, and historical inquiry aligned with the C3 Framework.
competencies: Investigate historical questions using multiple primary and secondary sources.
Analyze human and physical geography to understand how location and resources shape human decisions.
Explain economic concepts including production, market exchange, trade specialization, and public finance.
Apply democratic principles and civic virtues to deliberate contemporary public issues.

modules.title: World Geography & Cultural Heritage
modules.description: Locating continents, oceans, hemispheres, and exploring diverse global cultures, traditions, and human-environment interactions.

topics.title: Global Map Skills & Hemispheres
topics.description: Using latitude, longitude, the equator, and prime meridian to locate world regions.

topics.title: Cultural Traditions & Human Adaptation
topics.description: Investigating how communities around the globe adapt shelter, food, and clothing to local geography.

modules.title: Civic Responsibility & Global Economic Interdependence
modules.description: Studying universal human rights, global trade, import/export networks, and community problem-solving.

topics.title: Human Rights and Civic Leadership
topics.description: Examining global leaders who championed civil rights, democracy, and equality.

topics.title: Global Trade, Imports and Exports
topics.description: Tracking the supply chains of everyday products across international trading partners.
